pdm-cli-operations.description: Proxmox PDM fleet operations. Repo-scoped: installs only into repositories that own or operate the Proxmox environment, not broadcast to every consumer.

hermes-ops.description: Reviewed shared skills plus the homelab repo-scoped PDM operations skill, exposed to the standing Hermes operations runtime. Hermes is a bare-SKILL.md service runtime, not a Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini client: it reads skill directories from a read-only bind mount, so it has no client packaging format and declares no consumer. It declares the repo whose environment it operates so repo-targeted skills for that environment remain selectable.
